items.name: External APIs
items.text: Follow pagination cursors for incremental pulls. Store auth in Secrets Manager; write idempotently via Lambda, Glue, or AppFlow.

items.name: Rate Limits
items.text: Handle 429/Retry-After with exponential backoff + jitter (SDK standard/adaptive). Buffer spikes in SQS with max concurrency.

left.title: Outbound allowlists

points: Protect AWS targets with security groups
Allow only needed ports from CIDRs or SG refs
Prefer referencing security groups over static IPs

right.title: Inbound control

items: No immediate retry loops — use backoff + jitter; raising Lambda timeout won't fix throttling (scale capacity/pools).
NAT Gateway provides a stable outbound IP; security groups control inbound access to AWS resources.
Never hard-code API keys or pass them in job parameters — store them in Secrets Manager with rotation.
API Gateway caching lowers backend load on repeat reads, but cached responses can be stale.
